component.name: Crucible
component.summary: Every application on the desk as an object in a live Dolby Atmos scene

description.p: AC3Forge Crucible takes every application making sound on the machine, lets each be placed in a room, and streams the result live as E-AC-3 JOC (Dolby Atmos) to a receiver - or as Dolby Digital 5.1, multichannel PCM or stereo, following whatever the hardware accepts. Applications you have not placed form the 5.1 bed, and so does whichever is full-screen where the desktop lets Crucible ask - under X11 it can, under Wayland no client can.

On Linux it needs PipeWire: each application is tapped separately through its own stream node, and the silent device the applications play into is a PipeWire node Crucible creates while it runs and removes when it exits. No driver is installed and nothing is left behind.
